# Logistics & Supply Chain Registry

> A structured editorial reference registry explaining how logistics and supply chain services operate across jurisdictions.

Logistics & Supply Chain Registry provides neutral, jurisdiction-specific reference records. Records cover logistics coordination, freight transport, carrier authority, commercial vehicle compliance, customs, import/export, warehousing, fulfilment, contract logistics, third-party logistics (3PL), tax, permits, relevant authorities, legislation, process, documents, operating conditions and cross-border relevance.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://logisticsregistry.org/): Registry overview and coverage.
- [Jurisdictions](https://logisticsregistry.org/jurisdictions/): Full jurisdiction directory.
- [Privacy Policy](https://logisticsregistry.org/privacy-policy/)
- [Terms of Use](https://logisticsregistry.org/terms-of-use/)

## Intended use

Use this registry to identify the jurisdictional reference record relevant to a logistics or supply chain question. For a live operation, verify current requirements with the competent authority and qualified advisers. Registry content is editorial reference material only and is not legal, tax, Customs or logistics advice.
